answers.reasoning: Homogeneity scales the output: f(alpha*x)=alpha*f(x), not a constant output or sum. The source explicitly omits f on the RHS; the question declares the repair. Easy recognition.
f(3*1)=6; alpha*x=3; alpha*f(1)=3*2=6. The supplied linear map disproves the printed equality, not linearity. Easy substitution.

The new standalone stem identifies six revolute joints and three neighboring intersecting axes. Sufficient is implication from condition to the stated solvability result, not converse, universal reachability, or uniqueness. Medium distinction.

The little triangle has base k1,vertical k2,hypotenuse r=sqrt(k1^2+k2^2),gamma from base so atan2(k2,k1). x,y belong to the rotated target coordinates, not the displayed triangle legs. Easy diagram identification.

Substitute k1/r=cosgamma,k2/r=singamma into x=k1costheta1-k2sintheta1. Correct normalized expression is cosgamma costheta1-singamma sintheta1. Subtract both theta1 and theta2 from phi. theta3=phi-theta1-theta2, explicitly unlike the last p288 plus-theta2 typo. Easy one-step isolation.

A negative theta2 interval selects one branch; theta2prime=-theta2 supplies the reflected branch. They are generally distinct and merge at fully stretched/folded endpoints modulo2pi, which remain included. New o3 is coherent but false due to always. Medium branch interpretation.

The task words give desired body velocity(v,omega) and solve individual wheel rates. Page292 gives ur=(v+domega)/r and ul=(v-domega)/r. A final pose alone does not uniquely fix instantaneous rates; reverse mapping is forward velocity kinematics; geometry alone is insufficient. Easy definition.
